newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sampoerna says revises down 1996 forecast.
newsitem.headline: Sampoerna says revises down 1996 forecast.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna said on Thursday it was revising its projected 1996 full-year net profit down by five percent.

"The company (Sampoerna) is revising its projected full-year net income figure down by approximately five percent, to 423 billion rupiah," Sampoerna said in a statement after announcing that net profits for the nine months ending September 30 had risen to 330.49 billion rupiah from 264.17 billion rupiah in the year-ago period.
Sampoerna said the nine-month results reflected a slight deceleration in growth rates as the market responded to substantial increases in its product prices.
Volume and value growth continued to be robust for the nine months ending September 30, it said.
However, there were shortfalls of 4.8 percent on hand-made cigarettes and 2.5 percent on machine-made cigarettes against internal projections of rupiah sales during the period, it said.
The statement did not give further details.
